name: PT Trimitra Prawara Goldland Tbk
summary: PT Trimitra Prawara Goldland Tbk engages in the property development business in Indonesia. It operates through Sale of Houses and Rent segments. The company develops residential areas for middle- and lower-income communities. It also manages and leases properties. In addition, the company provides short-term accommodation services. Further, it manages restaurants, tourist lodges, youth hostels, and villas. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Trimitra Prawara Goldland Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Trimitra Prawara.
